Pricing Changes (August 2026)
Home
Mangomint Subscription

Pricing Changes (August 2026)

We want to make Mangomint affordable for everyone and allow as many people as possible to access the full suite of features available.

On August 1, 2026, all customers moved to our new and simpler pricing: $120/mo per location and $10/mo per user. Three add-ons are available: phone, marketing, and payroll. Everything else is included.

Link copied
What changed
Link copied

Previously, Mangomint offered three different plans: Essentials, Standard, and Unlimited. Each came with its own set of features, limits on the number of service providers, and different pricing for additional locations.

Now, there is only one simple plan for all Mangomint customers that provides access to all core features of the platform, such as Express Booking™, Memberships, Virtual Waiting Room, and HIPAA Compliance (requires signing a BAA).

In addition, we also simplified the add-ons available:

  • Forms & Charting is now included for free and available to every customer.

  • Web Chat, which was previously part of the Connect add-on, is now included for free and available to every customer.

  • All previously paid integration add-ons (Shopify, Webhooks, etc.) are now free and available to every customer.

  • Connect became Phone, and the price changed from $75/mo (+ $25/mo for additional locations) to $70/mo per line.

  • There is now a new, lower-priced tier available for marketing credits (usable with the Campaigns and Flows features) starting at $30/mo.

Mangomint's new pricing
Link copied

Mangomint subscription pricing is based on the number of locations and users:

  • $120/mo per location

  • $10/mo per user (deactivated and archived users are not counted)

All core features are included for everyone. In addition, three paid add-ons are available:

  • Phone: Includes unlimited calls and texts for $70/mo per line. Rates apply for outbound international calls.

  • Marketing: Pricing is based on the volume of marketing emails and text messages and measured with credits. Plans start at $30/mo.

  • Payroll Processing: Full-service payroll processing is available for $50/mo per payroll account + $8/mo per worker.

FAQs
Link copied

  • Link copied
    How much will I pay now?

    The new pricing went into effect on August 1, 2026 for all customers, and you can see the details above. If your new pricing came out higher than what you were previously paying, the price for your new plan did not change. We gave you credit for extra users to match your previous price.

  • Link copied
    What if my new pricing is higher?

    We grandfathered all existing customers for whom the price would have increased on their previous level. An email announcement was sent to every Admin on your account with further details. If you have any questions about it, please contact support.

  • Link copied
    What if my new pricing is lower?

    We hope you enjoy the extra cash! 😊

  • Link copied
    How much will I pay if I'm a solo provider?

    If you are a solo provider, you would pay $130/mo ($120 + $10), excluding any add-ons.

  • Link copied
    Who counts as a user?

    A user is anyone who is not deactivated or archived, regardless of whether they are a service provider.

  • Link copied
    Will users who work at multiple locations be charged twice?

    No, each user is only counted once, even if they're assigned to multiple locations.

  • Link copied
    Are text messages included in the plan?

    Automated text messages, such as appointment confirmations and reminders, are always included.

    Text messaging (two-way, back-and-forth conversations with clients) is available with the Phone add-on.

  • Link copied
    I used to have Connect, what changed?

    If you were previously subscribed to the Connect add-on, you were automatically subscribed to the new Phone add-on. The functionality did not change, but the price is now $70/mo per line instead of $75/mo (+ $25/mo for additional locations).

  • Link copied
    Is my account HIPAA compliant now?

    Not automatically. If you need HIPAA compliance, you will need to sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA). Please contact support for more details.
